reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; attacker is an unauthenticated-to-admin but otherwise authenticated user — untrusted entry point. Gate 3: src/app/dashboard/ is explicitly in scope. Code confirmed: OverallDashboardPage (page.tsx:32) calls getOverallStats() — which uses createSupabaseAdminClient() bypassing RLS (actions.ts:950) — without ever evaluating profile.is_admin as an access gate. An attacker can trigger this via a direct GET /dashboard/overall request by any authenticated non-admin member, causing full cross-user attendance statistics (today's headcount, total member count, 30-day activity hours, per-team/per-grade daily breakdowns) to be rendered without authorization.
